This '''major''' in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] commanded troops in the [[Battle of Xeron]] against a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] force that included an [[Imperial warbot]], which was captured by the Rebels. Later, the major turned the droid over to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to get a full technical schematic of it. When [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] was damaged trying to analyze the Warbot, the major suggested they try bringing it to [[Kligson's Moon/Legends|Kligson's Moon]].
